title: prview-review/1
description: A review of one change, anchored on its head commit. Producers write it; prview reads it. Fields prview does not know are ignored; values it cannot use are dropped, not fatal.

target.description: The change under review. The document only opens against `head`.

repo.description: owner/name for a hosted repo, else the repo's name

base.description: the commit the change is compared against (the merge base)

url.description: the pull request's URL, when there is one

platform.description: where the pull request lives, e.g. github

label.description: a short name for the change, e.g. owner/name#42 or main..feature

plan.description: The reading order. Optional: without chapters prview reads the change file by file.

by.description: who ordered the chapters; "files" means the file-by-file fallback

intent.description: one line, imperative, at most 12 words

mechanical.description: Written by prview for reference; recomputed by rule on every read, so a producer's value is ignored.

id.description: unique within the document; prview renames a repeat

source.description: the producer's name, shown beside the finding

line.description: a line number on `side`; one outside the hunk moves to the hunk's first line

kind.description: e.g. bug, security, correctness, design, test, perf

votes.description: how many of the producer's repeated runs raised this finding; leave out if it ran once

human.description: The reader's layer. A producer normally leaves it out.

hunk.description: null for a comment on the whole change

on_submit.description: Reserved. A command the producer wants run after the review is submitted; prview drops it on import until submission can show it and ask the human first.

hunk.description: path@oldStart:newStart from `git diff -M base head` (the numbers in the @@ header), or path@file for a file with no hunks
